title: Your roommate’s payment handle changed
scenario: Your roommate messages from their usual account: “My payment app is locked—send your share of rent to this new handle tonight.” The amount is exactly what you owe.

answers.A: Pay because the amount and timing match your real rent arrangement.
answers.B: Verify the change in person or by calling the roommate on a known number before sending money.
answers.C: Ask the landlord whether your share can be paid directly through the normal rent channel instead.

explanation: Compromised accounts inherit real history and timing. A changed payment destination is the moment to verify the person.
proTip: Correct amount, wrong destination is still a loss.
